description: Estimate generation cost before running. Seedance is billed in tokens (duration × width × height × 24 / 1024, at a $/M rate that differs per model and resolution); Veo and Kling are billed by the second; Gemini Omni is billed by tokens it decides after the fact, so its figure is a pessimistic guess. A Seedance 2.5 draft (generate_video draft: true) costs exactly a 480p take on 2.5 — price it with that model, not the default; its final (finish_draft) costs a 1080p take on 2.5 of the draft's duration and ratio, plus the draft's referenceVideoSec from take_status.

model.description: defaults to Seedance 2.0. Seedance: 4–15 s, adaptive ratio, references and voice samples (2.5: up to 30 s, 30 references). Veo: 16:9/9:16, duration 4, 6 or 8 only, no voice, Lite takes no references. Gemini Omni: no duration parameter (length is asked for in the prompt), no voice, price known only after the render. Kling: 16:9/9:16/1:1, 3–15 s, no references, no voice. Prices differ by an order of magnitude — ask estimate_cost first.

referenceVideoSec.description: total length of the @clips the prompt will reference — billed as input seconds on the cheaper video-input column (Seedance only)

name: estimate_cost
